step3_kappa_cav.disambiguation_note: This kappa_cav (~ phi^-18 * omega_drive / N_cage) is the Tavis-Cummings cavity decay rate for the biological substrate. It is a Tier 3 geometric linewidth proxy rather than an experimentally measured operational kappa. It is DISTINCT from the radical-pair recombination rate Gamma_rec (~ 100 MHz) used as the Misra-Sudarshan measurement rate in protocol_decoherence_audit.py. The two protocols answer different physical questions: kappa_cav is the cavity-cooperativity channel, while Gamma_rec is the recombination substrate channel; see step3_kappa docstring.

step5_eta_F.protected_subspace_resonance_label: assumed protected-subspace branch resonance (O.12/O.23 conditional; not an independently verified biological resonance)
step5_eta_F.Delta_ST_convention: Delta_ST_Hz is the declared input gap for the selected branch; bare_resonance_Hz records the radical-pair hyperfine reference; Delta_ST_effective_Hz/protected_subspace_resonance_Hz are the assumed protected-subspace branch values used for detuning, conditional on O.12/O.23.

substrates.range_propagation_note: eta_Zeno_range propagates both N_dipoles_cooperative_range and f_overlap_plausible_range where supplied; it is not only an N-range.
substrates.level_II_status_basis: DMC legs are candidate missing-leg controls, not necessary or sufficient conditions. O.21/O.23/O.34 and a typed, normalized, measured coupling remain open; eta_Zeno is only a conditional external-rate scenario.
substrates.cross_engine_verdict_alignment: eta_Zeno is a conditional external-rate robustness scenario; it represents the Tavis-Cummings cavity-QED cooperativity ratio g_coll / kappa_cav arithmetic after scenario inputs are supplied. DMC legs remain candidate controls; all branches still require the O.21 cooperative radical-pair/Polaron witness, O.23 protected subspace, and O.34 ATP-Trp redox-regeneration condition before any Level-II substrate status could be assigned; eta_Zeno is reported as a scenario rather than an independent Level-II threshold. No material descriptor executes a zero-coupling or categorical substrate verdict. This is DISTINCT from the bare Misra-Sudarshan extension verdict in protocol_decoherence_audit.py, which at canonical biological parameters returns BARE_MS_EXTENSION_INSUFFICIENT (about 2.8 ns diagnostic scale vs the 100 us-0.87 ms conditional band; the 10 ms conservative target remains unreached). The positive branch is therefore a candidate protected-subspace branch conditional on Open Problem O.23 closure (chiral phonon-polariton DFS providing a route toward the conditional operative band used by the Tavis-Cummings framing).

comparison_to_IIT_phi: IIT Phi is NP-hard over 2^N-1 system bipartitions (intractable for non-trivial systems). eta_Zeno is closed-form on substrate variables (nuclear-spin lattice, chirality, Tavis-Cummings cavity parameters) that GCT picks out as physically measurable. Tractability is the GCT advantage; substrate-coupling empirical dependence (Tier 3 inputs) is the cost.
